headline: 超级少女与奥德赛领跑今日热搜
headlineEn: Supergirl and Odyssey Lead Today's Trending
summary: 今日无新片上映，本周有4部新片。热搜榜超级少女、奥德赛领衔，后室、痴迷、安昂传奇紧随。本周热门包括揭秘日、蜘蛛侠崭新之日等。即将上映：蜘蛛侠崭新之日、OK女士2、逃出绝命街。
summaryEn: No movies released today, 4 new this week. Trending: Supergirl, Odyssey lead; Backrooms, Obsession, Avatar follow. Weekly hot includes Reveal Day, Spider-Man: Fresh Day. Upcoming: Spider-Man: Fresh Day, Okay Madam 2, Escape from Dead End Street.
